children: Overview
UK asset finance software firm's H1 revenue up 4% on strong subscription growth
Operating profit for H1 fell 15% year-on-year
Profitability impacted by lower software engineering revenue, severance costs, and FX losses
Outlook
Alfa expects to meet full-year expectations despite some project delays
Company sees slightly reduced delivery revenue for 2026, offset by improved software engineering revenues
Alfa expects 2026 cash conversion of 80%-90%, with long-term guidance at 90%-100%
Result Drivers
SUBSCRIPTION REVENUE - Co said 14% growth in subscription revenues and 17% rise in ARR drove overall revenue increase
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING DECLINE - Co said lower software engineering revenue, down 17% year-on-year, reduced profitability
SEVERANCE COSTS AND FX - Co said operating profit was impacted by severance costs for adjusting product engineering capacity and FX hedge losses
